_comment: unity-dev skill — project hook registration. This file is the PRIMARY and ONLY home of enforcement: settings hooks run in every session and inside subagents, while SKILL.md frontmatter hooks run only when the skill is active (a gap — do not move these there). Verify with /hooks after install; project-settings hooks require accepting the workspace trust dialog once.
_form: All hooks use exec form (command + args): the docs recommend it for any hook that references a path placeholder, because there is no shell to re-tokenize a project path containing spaces.
_no_if_on_the_gate: The PreToolUse guard deliberately carries no `if` filter. `if` would cut process spawns, but a filter that stops matching — a pattern-semantics change across versions, an unanticipated protected extension — turns the security gate into a silent no-op. The guard is a few milliseconds of bash; the codemap nudge below, where a miss is harmless, is where `if` is used.
